posts.title: WebKitGTK and WPE WebKit Security Advisory WSA-2026-0007
WPE WebKit 2.54.3 released
posts.description: This is a bug fix release in the stable 2.54 series. What’s new in WPE WebKit 2.54.3? Add User-Agent quirk for XBox Play. Add support for WebXR static layers. Add support for WebXR layer deletion. Support pressure-sensitive reporting for gamepad buttons. Reduce video format conversions when using the DMA-BUF video sink. Improve WebAudio graph rendering performance. Improve Web content process star

posts.title: WPE WebKit 2.54.2 released
posts.description: This is a bug fix release in the stable 2.54 series. What’s new in WPE WebKit 2.54.2? Fix performance when compositing layers with backdrop filters. Fix pre-warmed web process leak when they are rejected due to sandboxing. Release suspended pages and idle processes on memory pressure. Bind /dev/dxg in the Bubblewrap sandbox.
